name: GFDL CM2.6 ocean surface velocity fields (GZ21 training dataset)
access: Model files used for the online evaluation (GZ21) are accessible via Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7663062); CM2.6 data documented in Griffies et al. (2015) and Guillaumin & Zanna (2021).

scales.note: CM2.6 nominal 1/10 degree global ocean simulation; four subdomains used for GZ21 training
